messages.subject: Error when Using PreNormalized Data
parts:
Hi,

I have been trying to run MSstatsTMT on the same data set used in the original paper, (SpikeIn-5mix-MS2 data), but with the data normalized in MaxQuant (ratio to reference and match between runs on) and I get the following error when running this line of code.

proteinSummarization(input.mq,
                                          method="msstats",
                                          global_norm=FALSE,
                                          reference_norm=FALSE)  

"Error in merge.data.table(summarized, lab, by.x = c(merge_col, "Protein"),:
Elements listed in 'by.x' must be valid column names in x.

I assumed that by setting global_norm and reference_norm to FALSE, I would be able to input prenormalized data. Please let me know if this is not the case. Am I able to use MSstatsTMT when the data has already been normalized? Is there something else causing this error?

I am using MaxQuant version 1.6.17.0,  MSstatsTMT version 2.0.1, and R version 4.1.0. I have attached the evidence file, proteinGroups file, parameters file, and the code I used.

Best,
Elena

messages.subject: Re: Error when Using PreNormalized Data

Hi Elena,

MSstatsTMT currently does not support the analysis based on the ratios to reference. Many ratios are below 1.0 and those ratios will become negative after log transformation. Can you try to use the normalized intensities?

Best,
Ting
